products.name: Implementing Microsoft Purview — Foundation, Roles & Onboarding — Commercial
products.short_description: Implement Microsoft Purview properly — the portal, least-privilege role/RBAC model, core data services (Content/Activity Explorer, unified audit), Compliance Manager baseline, and workload connections — the foundation the rest of Purview builds on. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Stand up Microsoft Purview the right way — foundation, roles, and onboarding

Microsoft Purview is powerful and sprawling — and most orgs turn on pieces ad hoc without a foundation. This solution implements Purview properly: enable and organize the Purview portal, establish the role groups and RBAC (least-privilege for compliance/records/insider-risk/eDiscovery/audit), turn on the core data services (Content & Activity Explorer, unified audit), baseline Compliance Manager, connect the in-scope workloads, and set the operating foundation the rest of the Purview capabilities build on.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the Purview portal and capability map, the role/RBAC model, the core data services (Content/Activity Explorer, audit), Compliance Manager, and the phased-adoption approach.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (compliance licensing E3/E5, admin roles, in-scope workloads, stakeholders).
  • Implementation Guide — organize the portal, establish role groups + least-privilege RBAC, enable Content/Activity Explorer + unified audit, baseline Compliance Manager, connect workloads, and validate the foundation — pilot-first, each role/scope named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Security & Compliance PowerShell / Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (roles scoped, data services on, Compliance Manager baselined) plus Best Practices + a capability-adoption roadmap; licensing dependencies flagged to verify.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A Microsoft Purview foundation done right — portal organized, roles least-privileged, core services on, Compliance Manager baselined — so every Purview capability you add lands on solid ground.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • PURVIMP-Assess-Readiness.ps1 — read-only Microsoft Purview readiness, licensing, and role assessment (no changes)
    • PURVIMP-Enable-CoreServices.ps1 — core-services enablement checker/enabler for the unified audit log + Content/Activity Explorer roles (read-only by default; -Commit to enable audit)
    • PURVIMP-Report-ComplianceBaseline.ps1 — read-only compliance-signal baseline snapshot (Secure Score + audit + role posture) alongside the portal Compliance Manager score
    • PURVIMP-Scope-Config.ps1 — read-only workload scope/health helper: confirms in-scope M365 workloads and reports endpoint device-onboarding readiness
    • PURVIMP-Set-RoleGroups.ps1 — least-privilege Purview role-group / RBAC setup helper (-WhatIf by default; -Commit to apply)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
